WHAT WE USE AT VINYL WRAP TORONTO

AVERY DENNISON & 3M

When it comes to wrapping vehicles, using premium vinyl is critical for quality, longevity, and performance. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we only use vinyl wrap materials from Avery Dennison and 3M, two of the most trusted names in the industry. Our decision is based on their cost-effectiveness, extended lifespan, reliable performance, and minimal aftereffects.

Why We Use Avery Dennison & 3M

Avery Dennison and 3M vinyl wraps are backed by a 1-year manufacturer guarantee and are widely considered the gold standard in vehicle wrapping. Here’s why we trust these brands:

  • Quick Installation: Avery Dennison offers exceptional flexibility, making installation easier and faster. While 3M may require slightly more effort, it’s still far more efficient than other wrap materials on the market.
  • UV Protection: Both materials serve as a UV barrier, helping protect your vehicle’s paint from sun damage.
  • Scratch & Paint Protection: Their durability helps prevent paint damage, chipping, and scratches.
  • Strong Adhesive: Properly installed wraps from either brand will not peel or lift unless intentionally removed.
  • Easy Removal: Both offer clean removal without leaving residue, preserving your original paint.
  • Long Lifespan: With proper care, these wraps can last 5–7 years or more.
  • Wide Colour & Finish Selection: Avery and 3M offer extensive color palettes. 3M leads slightly in finish variety.
  • Cost-Effective: Considering the performance, lifespan, and low maintenance, these wraps provide excellent value.
  • Premium Appearance: A full wrap using either of these materials gives your vehicle a factory-quality finish indistinguishable from paint.

WHAT WE OFFER

We carry a full range of vinyl wrap solutions:

  • Coloured Vinyl Wraps with Laminate
  • Printable Vinyl Wraps with Laminate (For custom graphics)
  • Magnetic Vinyl Wraps (For temporary and removable signage)
  • Lamin-X Protective Films (Paint protection film, headlight/tail light tint, window tint)
  • COMING SOON: Ceramic Pro Nano Technology surface protection

WHY ONLY AVERY DENNISON & 3M?

Simply put: quality. These brands are leaders in the vinyl wrap industry and offer unmatched consistency, durability, and finish. We believe our customers deserve only the best—and that’s why we exclusively use Avery Dennison and 3M.

TOOLS WE USE

Applying a vinyl wrap requires precision, skill, and the right tools. Here are the essentials we use to ensure a flawless wrap:

  • Alcohol & Vinegar: We prep every surface using alcohol and vinegar to remove dust, oil, and debris for a smooth, clean finish.
  • Squeegees: These allow us to eliminate air bubbles and ensure firm adhesion.
  • Screwdrivers: For removing trim, emblems, and accessories to enable seamless wrap application.
  • Precision Knives & Blades: To cut vinyl cleanly and accurately.
  • Avery Dennison Wrap Gloves: Provide better grip and control during application, especially in corners and curves.
  • Premasking/Masking Tape: Helps position decals precisely and apply complex graphics correctly.

We pair top-tier vinyl with top-tier tools to deliver professional, long-lasting results.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What is the best colour to wrap my car?

The best colour depends on your personal style and purpose. Matte black is bold and modern, chrome finishes are flashy and luxurious, and colour-shift wraps make your car a showstopper. We offer a wide variety from both 3M and Avery Dennison to match any vision.

What are the pros and cons of vinyl car wraps?

Pros: Custom look, protects factory paint, removable, cost-effective compared to paint, available in endless finishes. Cons: Can be damaged by poor maintenance or improper installation. Lifespan depends on care.

How long do vinyl wraps last?

With proper maintenance, vinyl wraps from 3M and Avery Dennison typically last 5 to 7 years. Our installers will guide you with care tips to ensure maximum longevity.

What is the cost of wrapping a car?

Car wrap pricing in Toronto depends on vehicle size, wrap type (full, partial, or decals), and customisation level. Contact us for a personalised quote. We offer competitive rates using premium materials.

What’s the difference between Avery and 3M?

Both are industry leaders. Avery is more flexible and easier to install, while 3M has a broader colour range and may offer better adhesion in extreme conditions. Both provide excellent durability and finish.

What is the best brand for car wraps?

3M and Avery Dennison are widely regarded as the best vinyl wrap brands on the market for their quality, performance, and product innovation.

How do I maintain and clean a wrapped vehicle?

Hand wash your vehicle with a pH-balanced car soap. Avoid high-pressure washers and abrasive brushes. We’ll provide detailed aftercare instructions to keep your wrap looking great for years.
